description: Offline / hybrid / online mode configuration. Config only — no behavior changes. The six routing modules (intelligent_routing, handler_contract, budget_ledger, policy_resolver, queue_backend, runtime_executor) run identically in all three modes; mode only changes which external dependencies are reachable.

offline.description: No network. Local classifier, local adapters, local ledger, local queue, local SCAR log. Full-model tier is unavailable; PolicyResolver queues or denies full-tier requests.

hybrid.description: Local-first with optional online fallback. Local classifier and adapters run first; full-tier requests go through PolicyResolver capability + budget gates before any network call.

online.description: Full network. All tiers available. Same governance loop: classifier recommends, PolicyResolver authorizes, RuntimeExecutor mutates, SCAR records.

notes: Switching modes changes capabilities and network reachability only. It never bypasses PolicyResolver, BudgetLedger, or CircuitBreaker. A mode switch is itself an auditable event.
